# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old during her time at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bowman family; later moved to Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Former handmaiden at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a freckled face, a snubbed nose, and a very wide mouth and smile. In her earlier youth, she wore very blue bows in her hair, but as a young lady she discarded them and wore her hair in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Charlotta is warm-hearted, cheerful, and fiercely loyal to her mistress, Miss Lavendar. She is deeply appreciative of Anne Shirley, whom she wholeheartedly admires and attempts to imitate. Highly obedient and devoted, she puts up with any play-pretend games without judgment and worries constantly about the well-being of those she loves.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

- To serve and care for Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

## History

Charlotta the Fourth, whose real name is Leonora Bowman, was hired at age fourteen to work for Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge, following in the footsteps of her three older sisters who had each served Miss Lavendar and then departed for Boston. Miss Lavendar continued calling her Charlotta to avoid confusion. Charlotta warmly welcomed visitors like Anne Shirley and Diana Barry to Echo Lodge, developing a deep admiration for Anne and secretly practicing her manners in her bedroom mirror. When Miss Lavendar became quiet and depressed, Charlotta expressed deep worry for her mistress's health and happiness. She assisted with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's marriage to Stephen Irving and subsequently moved with them to Boston, where she initially experienced severe homesickness. Over time, she blossomed into a young woman, gave up her iconic hair ribbons for a pompadour hairstyle, and married a good-tempered bricklayer named Tom. She returned to Prince Edward Island for visits during the summers and attended Anne Shirley's wedding, enthusiastically throwing rice and old shoes at the departing couple.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the fourth sister in her family to serve Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She moved to Boston following Miss Lavendar's marriage  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- She married a bricklayer named Tom  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>

## Quotes

> Miss Lavendar isn’t well, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I’m sure she isn’t, though she never complains.  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

> Please, Miss Shirley, ma’am, it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums.  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

> I hope that he’ll marry Miss Lavendar. Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men. But Miss Lavendar never was.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>

> Goodness, no, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I wouldn’t know who he meant if he did. Of course, when we got married he had to say, 'I take thee, Leonora,’ and I declare to you, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’ve had the most dreadful feeling ever since that it wasn’t me he was talking to and I haven’t been rightly married at all.  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>

> Tom is only a bricklayer, but he’s real good-tempered. When I said to him, says I, 'Tom, can I go to Miss Shirley’s wedding? I mean to go anyhow, but I’d like to have your consent,’ he just says, 'Suit yourself, Charlotta, and you’ll suit me.’ That’s a real pleasant kind of husband to have, Miss Shirley, ma’am.  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>
